title: Implement _eval_derivative_n_times for sin class
description: Add the `_eval_derivative_n_times` method to the `sin` class in the trigonometric.py file. The method signature is `_eval_derivative_n_times(self, s, n)` where `s` is the symbol to differentiate with respect to and `n` is the number of derivatives. Implementation: if the argument equals `s`, return `sin(self.args[0] + n*pi/2)`. Otherwise return `None` to fall back to sympy's default repeated differentiation. The method should be added after the existing methods in the sin class, before the class definition ends.
expected_output: The complete modified Python file with the `_eval_derivative_n_times` method added to the `sin` class. The method returns sin(arg + n*pi/2) when differentiating with respect to the argument variable.
